prompts.insurance:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: premium Chinese enterprise software website panoramic hero background. Create a single coherent editorial business photograph, wide 2:1 composition. Realistic modern Chinese professional workplace, restrained navy-blue and warm neutral lighting, refined architectural details. Main human activity on the left third and lower-left, natural front or three-quarter facial views, medium-wide camera framing, people proportional and slightly below the vertical midpoint. Center and right are quiet, spacious architectural background with only minimal context; leave the middle uncluttered for an overlaid software interface. The scene must remain readable when a dark gradient is applied over the left. Natural anatomy, realistic hands and meaningful document handling, no person with a broad back toward camera, no oversized chair backs. No fantasy technology, holograms, robots, blue glowing lines, staged handshakes, busy collage, packed text, logos, watermarks, page numbers or tiny pseudo-text. No independent decorative horizontal line, border, color stripe, or accent bar along the top edge. Do not render a software dashboard. Screens may be angled away and unobtrusive. Materials and props must convey the specific business below, with no readable personal data.
Specific business scene: An insurance adviser and an adult policyholder seated at an open consultation desk on the LEFT, reviewing a policy booklet, claim application and a small orderly set of supporting papers. A second insurance operations professional beside the desk checks a document. Calm service conversation, attentive expressions, natural modest gestures. High-end insurance customer service lounge, quiet neutral center wall and softly lit glass meeting rooms on the right. No hospital, no doctor, no medical imagery, no cash or banking counter.
